persona_holdout.note: s7_s3c_convention; test personas never in train

od_holdout.note: train/val/test ODs pairwise disjoint; every test state uses only test ODs and test personas (double holdout)

accessibility_holdout.held_out_from_train: feasible ODs with walking burden access_time+egress_time >= 15 min (high-burden profiles appear only in test)
accessibility_holdout.transfer_rule: planner caps at 1 vehicle-to-vehicle transfer (same routing rule as MATSimAdapter._plan_pt)
accessibility_holdout.class_e_policy: Class E (infeasible) present in every split (FVR learnable + testable)

identity_leakage.check: build assertion in src/traveler_distillation/accessibility/accessibility_dataset.py (every stop_id/route_id/node id string is forbidden in student/teacher-facing state)

note: Manifest records identities/checksums; bulk data files remain at their original paths (not duplicated).
